verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that anyone can publish and consume providers, modules, and policies on the public Terraform Registry, and that modules are the mechanism for reusable configurations that can be versioned and shared. The registry's module catalog is also exposed through the official MCP server. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the publishing workflow (versioning, source requirements) and module-consumption syntax, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of registry use (community mentions modules only as awkward to use).
